recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Breath as Prayer and Templīs Aquária", "body": "Chance used the announcement slot to point listeners toward Kalina Lux, who had just appeared on Crrow777 Radio. He said she started a church in Puerto Rico, run as a private member association, that supplies people with religious exemption paperwork. Chance relayed her point that their prayer is the breath, and that staying connected with spirit through respiration amplifies the ability to manifest what one intends. He tied the story back to an earlier talk about private and public, and posted links to her earlier InnerVerse interview from about a year before."}, {"title": "Elemental Magic, Infused Tea and Everyday Alchemy", "body": "Rachel named elemental magic as her favorite system, describing it as balancing the elements to support medicine, health and the world around you, a conscious magic practiced almost without thinking. One of the hosts described checking his own elements when his flow stalled, asking whether he was cold, hungry, tired or short on breath. Rachel called cooking one of the easiest forms of alchemy, and she described setting a stone in clean water under the sun, then pairing it with herbs chosen for a body area, as a way of working with earth, water and resonance."}, {"title": "Brigid, the Forge and the Black Madonna", "body": "Rachel described Brigid as a creator goddess linked to poetry, blacksmithing and healing, and said she felt a personal connection to her at this time of year. In a recorded call-in, Gabe asked whether the Black Madonna might relate to the Star card in Aquarius season. One of the hosts said the Black Madonna was not familiar ground, so the question waited for Gabe to join live. He then suggested that a patroness of the forge would be covered in soot, echoing the explanation often given for dark statues. Rachel mapped smithing, medicine and poetry onto physical, in between and higher bodies."}, {"title": "Gene Key 25 and the Shadow of Constriction", "body": "Rachel explained Gene Keys as a blend of the I Ching and astrology, with each key moving from shadow to gift to highest state. Gene Key 25 became the worked example because it matched episode 25 and doubled up in one of their charts. Reading from the Gene Keys book, one of them said constriction exists where love is absent, appearing as a repressive form that stays ignorant or a reactive form that turns cold. They agreed the gift was openness and acceptance of love, and that the highest state of the key was universal love."}, {"title": "Rachel's Hand Drawn Charts, Runes and Void Mudra", "body": "Rachel showed a hand drawn seasonal wheel that she said she realized afterward followed the Fibonacci sequence, with thirteen constellations, eight fire festivals and a fifth element she chose as metal, a conduit between water and fire. She also showed a rune world tree in colored pencil, with Chinese medicine organs and energy centers added, and described singing the runes as a healing practice. Rachel demonstrated a void mudra that she said came to her spontaneously, held pointing downward at hip level, and the talk that followed described the void as space where nothing and everything exist at once."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: The great Rachel Munoz joins us for the 2-2-2022 show! An avid researcher of various systems of self-gnosis, Rachel also innovates her own ways of deepening a personal relationship with the divine. Topics on the table are Gene Keys, Runes, and building your own systems through reforging archetypal associations to suit one's desired purpose in life.
